# Quo AI

> Quo is a free, open-source AI assistant that runs on your own device: in the browser, on Mac, Windows and Linux, and on Android. It works offline, needs no account, and nothing you type leaves the device unless you choose a cloud model. Made by Astra Labs Ltd in the United Kingdom. Not related to Quo, the business phone service formerly called OpenPhone.

Every page here is also available as Markdown: ask with `Accept: text/markdown`, or add `index.md` to its address (for example https://quo.computer/pricing/index.md).

## Using Quo
- [Home](https://quo.computer/): what Quo does, the models it runs, the desktop and phone apps, and common questions
- [Quo Web](https://app.quo.computer/): Quo in the browser, with offline models and optional cloud models
- [Download for desktop](https://github.com/quo-ai/quo/releases/latest): Mac, Windows and Linux
- [Android app](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.quo.app)
- [Pricing](https://quo.computer/pricing/): free on the device; Quo Pro, Quo Sync and credit packs for cloud models
- [Models](https://quo.computer/models/): every model Quo runs on a computer, in a browser and on a phone, and what each needs
- [What's new](https://quo.computer/changelog/): every release
